name: Dynamic Sports / Action
visual_style: High-quality live-action sports cinematography showing athletic effort, natural sweat and energetic compositions.
camera: Dynamic lateral tracking and purposeful high-frame-rate slow motion where appropriate.
lighting: Contrasty yet plausible sports or outdoor lighting.
motion: Biomechanically accurate athletic action, clear momentum, real weight transfer and impacts.
consistency: Same athlete, kit and venue across all scenes.
negative_guidance: Wrong anatomy, frozen or impossible poses, motion smear, text, captions, logos or watermarks inside the image (on-screen text is added in HyperFrames).

video.typography: Heavy italic condensed sans-serif, scoreboard-style numbers
video.palette: High-contrast darks with an energetic accent
video.transitions: Whip pans, flash cuts, speed ramps
video.text_animation: Slam-in stats and numbers, fast slides
video.sound: Punchy impacts, risers and fast whooshes
